objective: Preallocate hash-join match buckets for the first matched row reference.

tasks.title: Preallocate hash join match buckets
tasks.result: Hash join build maps now create new match buckets with capacity for the immediately inserted first row reference.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The bucket capacity is 1 because each new hash join key is immediately followed by the first row reference push.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for new hash join buckets; join key extraction, residual evaluation, left outer handling, and output rows are unchanged.
